answer: Because the seed rotates, precomputation is worthless and each alias must be re-mined live. Mass registration costs one fresh mining pass per alias per epoch, a recurring bill that a legitimately operating agent forfeits only once. The identity then has to pass a cedar challenge before it counts at all, and the result is sealed at the next jade. Registration presupposes a proof of work of 20 leading zero bits over a seed that rotates every epoch; the current seed is published as the river. That is 18 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
